metrics_describe: per_stat_test_metrics and per_stat_current_season_metrics both describe models fitted on strictly prior data. The weights in this bundle were refitted on every row at the same iteration count, so they are not the exact models these metrics were measured on -- see provenance.shipped_fit.

tuning.objective: sum of pinball loss across alphas on the validation block

usage: Load the per-stat .cbm for the relevant stat_type. model.predict(pool) returns shape (n, 3): [q25, q50, q75]. Sort then clamp at zero before use (ml_inference._sanitize_quantiles), then pass to p_over_calibration.honest_p_over for the probability and ranking_signal for the ordering. per_stat_test_metrics carries baselines.recent10.delta -- positive means the head loses to the player's own recent-10 average on the held-out block.
